name: command-code-delegate
description: Delegate code implementation, test authoring/execution, and build/lint/type checks by default to a configured Command Code CLI worker: implement, self-verify, fix, and re-verify, then hand the final diff back to the main model for planning, work breakdown, and independent final review. Only clear micro-edits under all listed criteria are handled directly by the main model; anything uncertain is delegated.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation and tests to a configured Command Code worker
interface.longDescription: Delegate code implementation, test authoring/execution, and build/lint/type checks by default to a configured Command Code CLI worker: the worker implements, self-verifies, fixes, and re-verifies, then hands the final diff back to the main model for requirements, planning, work breakdown, and independent final review. Covers full features and complex work split into scoped worker tasks; only clear micro-edits under all listed criteria are handled directly by the main model, anything uncertain is delegated, and other follow-up fixes and retests stay with the worker. The main model reserves itself for design decisions and final acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this implementation and its tests to Command Code, then verify the result.
Review the delegated worker's final diff before accepting it.
